articles.title: BR-163 deve ter 29% mais carros no feriado de Nossa Senhora Aparecida | G1
articles.standfirst: Aumento no fluxo de automóveis é previsto para segunda-feira (12), mas movimento já deve crescer nesta sexta-feira (9). Atendimento aos motoristas será reforçado.
articles.summary: Aumento no fluxo de automóveis é previsto para segunda-feira (12), mas movimento já deve crescer nesta sexta (9). Atendimento aos motoristas será reforçado.
articles.body:
BR-163 deve ter 29,2% mais carros no feriado de Nossa Senhora Aparecida em MT — Foto: Nova Rota do Oeste

O fluxo de carros na BR-163, em Mato Grosso, deve aumentar 29,2% no feriado de Nossa Senhora Aparecida, nesta segunda-feira (12), em comparação aos dias comuns. A previsão é de um estudo de tráfego da Nova Rota do Oeste, concessionária responsável pela rodovia. O movimento de quem vai viajar, no entanto, já deve começar a crescer nesta sexta-feira (9) . Para a data, a estimativa é de 18,5% mais automóveis na estrada.

Enquanto a circulação de carros deve aumentar, a projeção aponta redução no tráfego de veículos pesados, como caminhões e carretas. A queda prevista é de 11% nesta sexta e de 9,5% na segunda-feira.

Com a expectativa de maior movimento durante o feriado prolongado, a concessionária inicia nesta sexta-feira a Operação Rota à Vista . As equipes de atendimento ficarão em pontos estratégicos da rodovia para reduzir o tempo de resposta aos chamados dos motoristas.

O atendimento funciona 24 horas por dia pelo telefone 0800 065 0163 , por ligação ou WhatsApp. Pelo mesmo canal, é possível consultar as condições de tráfego, as intervenções na estrada e outras situações que possam afetar a viagem.

Antes de sair de casa, a orientação da concessionária é verificar as condições do veículo e planejar o percurso. A manutenção preventiva deve incluir pneus, freios, iluminação e níveis de óleo e água.

Também é importante definir os pontos de abastecimento ao longo do caminho para evitar a pane seca, quando o veículo fica parado por falta de combustível.

Durante a viagem, os motoristas devem respeitar os limites de velocidade e a sinalização, além de manter uma distância segura do veículo à frente. Nos trechos com obras ou mudanças no tráfego, a recomendação é redobrar a atenção e seguir as orientações das equipes que trabalham na rodovia.

Para quem viaja com crianças, a concessionária reforça a necessidade de usar os dispositivos de retenção adequados à idade e ao tamanho dos passageiros. Todos os ocupantes devem utilizar o cinto de segurança.

articles.title: Evento gratuito promove três dias de saúde e bem-estar em Santos | G1
articles.standfirst: SDW Wellness acontece entre 15 e 17 de outubro e reúne especialistas, profissionais da saúde e experiências voltadas à prevenção, movimento e longevidade
articles.summary: SDW Wellness acontece entre 15 e 17 de outubro e reúne especialistas, profissionais da saúde e experiências voltadas à prevenção, movimento e longevidade
articles.body:
Evento gratuito promove três dias de saúde e bem-estar em Santos — Foto: Divulgação

Cuidar da saúde vai muito além de fazer exames ou procurar um médico quando algum problema aparece. Dormir melhor, manter uma alimentação equilibrada, praticar atividade física, cuidar da saúde mental, prevenir doenças e buscar mais qualidade de vida são atitudes que fazem parte de uma rotina cada vez mais voltada ao bem-estar e à longevidade.

É com essa proposta que Santos recebe, nos dias 15, 16 e 17 de outubro, o SDW Wellness , um dos grandes encontros dedicados à saúde, longevidade e bem-estar do País. Com entrada gratuita mediante inscrição , o evento será realizado no Santos Convention Center , na Ponta da Praia, e reunirá conteúdos, experiências, profissionais, marcas e soluções relacionadas ao universo wellness.

A programação foi pensada para aproximar o público de temas que fazem parte da vida cotidiana, transformando assuntos relacionados à saúde em uma experiência acessível, prática e inspiradora.

O SDW Wellness não é voltado exclusivamente a profissionais da área da saúde. A proposta é receber pessoas com diferentes perfis e objetivos.

Quem já pratica exercícios, quem deseja começar uma atividade física, quem busca emagrecer com saúde, melhorar o sono, ter mais disposição, controlar o estresse ou simplesmente descobrir novas maneiras de cuidar de si encontrará conteúdos e experiências durante os três dias de programação.

O público poderá acompanhar palestras e talks, participar de experiências, visitar uma feira wellness, conhecer marcas, conversar com especialistas e descobrir novas possibilidades relacionadas à saúde e à qualidade de vida .

A proposta é mostrar que cuidar de si não precisa ser algo distante ou complicado. Muitas vezes, uma mudança pode começar com uma informação, uma conversa ou a decisão de adotar um novo hábito.

Um dos conceitos que norteiam o evento é a compreensão de que saúde não se resume à ausência de doenças. Energia para realizar as atividades do dia, qualidade do sono, alimentação equilibrada, equilíbrio emocional, movimento e autonomia também fazem parte de uma vida saudável.

Por isso, a programação do SDW Wellness aborda diferentes aspectos do bem-estar, incluindo prevenção, longevidade, nutrição, sono, energia, saúde mental, movimento, estética, autocuidado e qualidade de vida.

Ao reunir diferentes perspectivas, o evento busca mostrar que a construção de uma vida mais saudável é resultado de diversas escolhas realizadas ao longo do tempo.

A escolha de Santos para receber o evento também dialoga com características marcantes da cidade. A relação com a praia, o esporte, as atividades ao ar livre, o movimento e a busca por qualidade de vida fazem do município um cenário natural para uma iniciativa dedicada ao bem-estar.

Durante os três dias, o Santos Convention Center será o ponto de encontro para quem deseja conhecer novas ideias, experiências e soluções relacionadas à saúde e à longevidade.

Mais do que acompanhar palestras, os visitantes poderão vivenciar diferentes possibilidades ligadas ao universo wellness e estabelecer contato com profissionais e empresas que atuam nesse mercado.

A programação também contará com a participação de profissionais, atletas e personalidades ligadas à saúde, performance, movimento e longevidade.

Entre os nomes confirmados estão Dr. Thiago Volpi , médico nutrólogo e fundador do Espaço Volpi; Erasmo Viana , empresário, influenciador e cofundador do Mahamudra Brasil; Aline Becker , nutricionista e profissional de Educação Física especializada em emagrecimento feminino; Tiago Mecabo , ex-atleta da Seleção Brasileira e treinador de corrida; Thiago Monteiro , nutricionista, palestrante e mentor, com passagem pelo Flamengo e atuação junto à Seleção Brasileira Sub-20; Norton Mello , educador físico, empresário e personal trainer; Israel Affonso , profissional de Educação Física, especialista em Pilates e fundador do IS Workout Center; Vanessa Goltzman , especialista em saúde integrativa e emagrecimento metabólico; e Dra. Walkyria Fernandes , PhD em Fisioterapia.

A diversidade de especialistas reforça a proposta de apresentar a saúde de maneira ampla, conectando diferentes áreas e mostrando que bem-estar, prevenção, movimento e longevidade estão diretamente relacionados.

O evento também terá espaço dedicado ao mercado da saúde. O Palco Negócios foi criado para profissionais, clínicas, empresas e empreendedores que atuam no setor.

A programação incluirá palestras e painéis sobre temas como gestão, posicionamento, comunicação, marca, experiência do cliente, liderança, tributação, crescimento comercial e oportunidades no mercado de saúde, longevidade e bem-estar.

A iniciativa amplia o alcance do evento ao conectar o público interessado em cuidar melhor da saúde aos profissionais e empresas que desenvolvem produtos, serviços e soluções para esse segmento.

Uma experiência para colocar a saúde no centro da rotina

Em meio a uma rotina cada vez mais acelerada, encontrar tempo para cuidar de si pode se tornar um desafio. O SDW Wellness surge justamente como uma oportunidade para parar, conhecer novas possibilidades e refletir sobre escolhas que podem contribuir para uma vida mais saudável.

A proposta não é buscar perfeição, mas incentivar pequenas mudanças possíveis no dia a dia. Melhorar o sono, voltar a se movimentar, rever hábitos alimentares, cuidar da saúde mental, buscar acompanhamento profissional ou simplesmente dedicar mais atenção ao próprio corpo podem ser os primeiros passos importantes.

articles.title: Infecção urinária pega na relação sexual? Entenda | G1
articles.standfirst: Veja quando pode ocorrer a infecção urinária e se pode acontecer durante a relação sexual. Veja quais são os sintomas e o que ajuda na prevenção.
articles.summary: Veja quando pode ocorrer a infecção urinária e se pode acontecer durante a relação sexual. Veja quais são os sintomas e o que ajuda na prevenção.
articles.body:
Infecção urinária pega na relação sexual? Entenda — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação

Infecção urinária pega na relação sexual? Entenda o que acontece e como se proteger

A relação sexual pode desencadear uma infecção urinária e esse tipo de situação acontece com relativa frequência nas mulheres. O ato sexual não causa a infecção sozinho, mas pode facilitar a entrada de bactérias que já vivem na uretra feminina, que é o canal que leva a urina para fora da bexiga.

A explicação desse tipo de infecção está na anatomia: a distância entre a uretra e o ânus é bem menor nas mulheres do que nos homens. Durante a fricção sexual, o movimento pode ajudar a empurrar as bactérias da região genital e intestinal para dentro da uretra. A Escherichia coli, presente naturalmente no intestino, responde por até 95% dos casos de infecção urinária e é a principal responsável por esse quadro depois do sexo.

Enquanto você ajusta sua rotina para reduzir o risco, é importante manter a higiene frequente da região genital. Na Drogal, você encontra uma linha inteira de antissépticos para as vias urinárias para ter sempre quando precisar.

Por que a relação sexual pode causar infecção urinária?

Esse quadro tem até nome popular: cistite da lua de mel. Ele aparece nas primeiras 24 a 48 horas depois do sexo e não tem relação com a higiene do parceiro, nem é uma infecção sexualmente transmissível.

O mecanismo é simples: a fricção do ato sexual favorece a movimentação das bactérias que já estão presentes ao redor da abertura da uretra para dentro do trato urinário feminino.

Esse risco aumenta com a frequência da atividade sexual. Estudos indicam que a infecção do trato urinário é uma das mais frequentes em mulheres em idade sexual ativa. Estima-se que de 50% a 60% das mulheres poderá desenvolver pelo menos um episódio de infecção urinária na vida.

Quais são os sintomas de infecção urinária depois do sexo

Fique atenta aos sinais abaixo, principalmente quando aparecerem após as relações:

Vontade frequente de urinar, mesmo com a bexiga quase vazia;

O que ajuda a aliviar o desconforto da infecção urinária

A fenazopiridina é um composto usado para aliviar a dor e a ardência ao urinar, já que age direto na mucosa do trato urinário. Ela não trata a bactéria causadora da infecção, então funciona como um alívio para o desconforto enquanto você aguarda a consulta ou o início do tratamento prescrito pelo médico.

A Drogal dispõe de medicamentos à base de fenazopiridina disponíveis para esse alívio pontual, sempre sob orientação médica.

Como reduzir o risco de infecção depois das relações sexuais

Alguns hábitos simples podem fazer a diferença durante a prevenção:

Faça xixi logo depois da relação sexual, para ajudar a eliminar as bactérias que possam ter entrado na uretra;

Beba água ao longo do dia, o que dilui a urina e reduz a concentração de bactérias;

Faça a higiene da região genital antes e depois das relações sexuais;

Evite segurar a vontade de fazer xixi por longos períodos.

É importante consumir pelo menos dois litros de água diariamente. Alguns estudos indicam que o consumo pode ser calculado multiplicando seu peso (em quilogramas) por 35 ml/dia de água. Uma mulher que pese 60 kg deveria tomar cerca de 2,1 litros de água por dia.

Além da hidratação do organismo, urinar com frequência evita ajuda na “limpeza” do sistema renal e urinário. Em épocas de calor intenso, o consumo regular de água também tem outros benefícios para a saúde. Não deixe de beber água.

Quem tem episódios recorrentes pode usar antisséptico urinário?

Em casos nos quais a infecção urinária é recorrente, após as relações sexuais, o médico pode indicar um antisséptico para o uso preventivo. A combinação de metinamina com azul de metileno age contra as bactérias das vias urinárias. Seu efeito pode acontecer entre as 24 e 48 horas e pode durar até 12 horas por dose.

Na Drogal, você encontra compostos à base de metinamina e azul de metileno indicados para esse tipo de prevenção, sempre a partir da avaliação médica.

Marque a consulta sempre que os sintomas aparecerem, ainda que eles pareçam leves no início. Quando não tratada devidamente, a infecção urinária pode subir até os rins e se tornar mais séria.

Se os episódios continuarem se repetindo depois das relações sexuais, é importante informar o médico. O especialista poderá traçar estratégias de prevenção para esse tipo de caso.

articles.title: Gari é aprovado em exame da OAB e história emociona em Goiás  | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o advogado, a mãe Ivani Vavier de Souza foi a inspiração para continuar os estudos e e perseguir uma vida melhor. Antônio José contou que abdicava dos sábados, domingos e feriados para estudar.
articles.summary: Segundo o advogado, a mãe foi a inspiração para continuar os estudos e e perseguir uma vida melhor.  Antônio contou que abdicava dos sábados, domingos e feriados.
articles.body:
O gari Antônio José Júnior de Oliveira foi aprovado no exame da Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB) e tem emocionado pessoas com a história de superação. Segundo o advogado, a mãe Ivani Vavier de Souza foi a inspiração para continuar os estudos e e perseguir uma vida melhor.

"Ela nos criou trabalhando como empregada doméstica, passando roupa, mas sempre nos ensinou a importância dos estudos, para buscar uma vida melhor e servir à sociedade", declarou ao g1.

Antônio trabalhou na Companhia de Urbanização de Goiânia (Comurg) por 18 anos, dos quais 13 na coleta orgânica, três na coleta seletiva e um ano e meio na varrição. Com o apoio da companhia, ele conciliou estudos da faculdade com o trabalho nas ruas.

Gari é aprovado em exame da OAB e história emociona em Goiás — Foto: Divulgação/Comurg e Arquivo pessoal de Antônio José Júnior de Oliveira

Ele tinha aulas das 8h às 12h no Centro Universo Goiânia, fazia o estágio à tarde, por três horas em audiências, e trabalhava das 16h às 22h. Antônio cursou a graduação com uma bolsa de estudos da própria intituição. O novo advogado revelou ainda que abdicava dos sábados, domingos e feriados para estudar.

“A grande dificuldade era a disciplina de estudo e a dedicação, pois o curso de Direito exige muito tempo de estudo”, disse. O Centro Universo Goiânia informou que Antônio se formou em quatro anos e meio e foi juramentista do curso. Formado no mês de julho, Antônio contou que abriu seu próprio escritório em agosto e está atuando na área trabalhista.

“O Direito do Trabalho é uma forma de trazer justiça e de pacificar a sociedade. O meu propósito é servir à sociedade, trazer paz e ajudar as pessoas a resolver seus problemas”, declarou.

Antônio esclareceu que está conciliando as atividades como advogado e o trabalho na Comurg. "Fiz um concurso interno de meritocracia na Comurg, assumi a função de supervisor de abastecimento de combustível, e trabalho no escritório na parte da tarde", esclareceu.

articles.title: Governo Trump impõe sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional | G1
articles.standfirst: Em documento obtido pela Reuters, Marco Rubio chama o TPI de "tribunal desonesto". A corte internacional condenou a decisão, que classificou como um "ataque ao Estado de Direito".
articles.summary: Em documento obtido pela Reuters, Marco Rubio chama o TPI de "tribunal desonesto". A corte internacional condenou a decisão, que classificou como um "ataque ao Estado de Direito".
articles.body:
O governo do presidente dos Estados Unidos , Donald Trump , impôs sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional nesta sexta-feira (9), horas depois de uma das ex-juízas do TPI, Navi Pillay, ser anunciada como a ganhadora do Prêmio Nobel da Paz de 2026.

👉 Não é de hoje que Washington demonstra hostilidade em relação à corte , com imposição de sanções a seus promotores e juízes . No entanto, a medida de agora vai além, podendo punir empresas que prestam serviços ao tribunal.

A agência de notícias Reuters teve acesso a um comunicado assinado pelo secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio , antes do anúncio oficial da decisão. Pouco depois, o Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA confirmou a medida.

"O presidente Trump jamais permitirá que o Tribunal Penal Internacional processe cidadãos americanos. [...] Proibiremos transações com esse tribunal desonesto, cortando seus recursos e prejudicando sua capacidade de operar", disse Rubio.

Em um pronunciamento em vídeo, Rubio defendeu acabar com o TPI. "Ou o TPI acabará com suas ameaças, ou nós acabaremos com o TPI". O secretário também solicitou que seus aliados façam pressão sobre a Corte.

"E esperamos que nossos aliados, muitos dos quais fazem parte do TPI e dependem dos militares americanos para sua defesa, controlem esse tribunal fora de controle".

O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, apertam as mãos enquanto Rubio discursa durante uma recepção do Mês da Herança Hispânica no Salão Leste da Casa Branca, em Washington, DC, EUA, em 30 de setembro de 2026 — Foto: REUTERS/Jonathan Ernst

Procurada pela Reuters para comentar a decisão, a vice-procuradora do TPI, Nazhat Shameem Khan, condenou as sanções e afirmou que elas "devem ser condenadas", mas que não interromperão o trabalho do tribunal.

"As sanções visam minar o Estado de Direito internacionalmente e o trabalho que uma instituição judicial independente está realizando. Nosso trabalho continuará em todas as nossas situações, nossas investigações e nossos processos", disse Khan.

Em comunicado oficial, o TPI pediu que seus membros garantam a continuidade do trabalho do tribunal e condenou a atitude dos EUA:

"Trata-se de uma tentativa de obstruir o curso da justiça e impedir que o Tribunal faça aquilo para o qual foi criado. É um ataque ao Estado de Direito e aos próprios fundamentos da ordem jurídica internacional".

➡️ O Tribunal Penal Internacional é sediado na Holanda e foi fundado em 2002 para julgar crimes de guerra, crimes contra a humanidade e genocídio. Ele conta com 125 países como Estados-membros, incluindo todos os países da União Europeia e todos os membros da aliança da Otan, com exceção dos Estados Unidos e da Turquia.

Tesouro dos EUA anuncia sanções contra o Tribunal Penal Internacional — Foto: Departamento de Tesouro dos EUA / Divulgação

Europa, Canadá e Japão anunciam apoio ao TPI

Os ministros das Relações Exteriores de vários países europeus, além do Canadá e do Japão, reafirmaram nesta sexta seu apoio inabalável ao Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI), em uma declaração conjunta.

“Se forem implementadas, essas sanções terão um impacto significativo sobre o trabalho do Tribunal, seus dedicados funcionários e suas famílias”, afirmaram os ministros de Canadá, Dinamarca, Alemanha, França, Itália, Japão, Países Baixos e Reino Unido.

A Comissão Europeia, principal órgão executivo da União Europeia, também se pronunciou e garantiu que atenderá o pedido do tribunal e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com o TPI para garantir que ele continue a operar eficazmente.

Também afirmou que, apesar do anúncio dos EUA ser "profundamente lamentável", por questões burocráticas, é possível que ainda se consiga reverter a situação: "Como há um prazo de seis meses antes que as medidas sejam aplicáveis, há espaço para o diálogo".

O atual governo americano vêm se posicionando sistematicamente contra decisões do TPI , como por exemplo a emissão de mandados de prisão contra autoridades israelenses, incluindo o primeiro-ministro Benjamin Netanyahu.

A medida foi resultado direto do trabalho de Navi Pillay. Em setembro do ano passado, na ONU, ela supervisionou a publicação de um relatório da Comissão de Inquérito que concluiu que Israel cometeu genocídio em Gaza e que altos funcionários israelenses, incluindo o premiê, incitaram esses atos.

Israel classificou as acusações como "escandalosas".

Em agosto, quando Washington sancionou a presidente da Corte, países da Europa e o Japão fizeram críticas ao que o TPI chamou de um "ataque flagrante" à independência do tribunal.

Navi Pillay alfinetou Trump ao agradecer

Jurista sul-africana Navi Pillay discursa em Nuremberg, na Alemanha, após vencer o prêmio Nobel da Paz em 9 de outubro de 2026. — Foto: Agnes Callamard via REUTERS

Ao saber que foi escolhida para receber o Prêmio Nobel da Paz 2026, a jurista sul-africana Navi Pillay alfinetou o presidente Donald Trump , e se disse surpresa com a premiação.

Ovacionada no Palácio de Justiça de Nuremberg, na Alemanha, onde participava de um congresso sexta-feira (9), Pillay brincou: "Talvez eu divida esse prêmio com [Donald] Trump ".

"Se vocês aplaudirem mais um pouco, talvez eu divida esse prêmio com (Donald) Trump", disse a laureada, que também afirmou ter ficado surpresa com sua premiação. "Sendo advogada e juíza, eu ainda quero verificar essa informação [do prêmio Nobel]", disse.

👉 Além de alfinetar Trump, que defendia a sua própria candidatura ao Nobel da Paz, a jurista sul-africana também fez referência à oposicionista venezuelana Maria Corina Machado . Laureada com o prêmio no ano passado, ela entregou a medalha do Nobel da Paz a Donald Trump e dedicou o prêmio ao presidente dos EUA, de quem é aliada .

Mais tarde, a sul-africana voltou a fazer referência ao presidente norte-americano , ao criticar países que têm "atacado" o Tribunal Penal Internacional, alvo constante do governo Trump.

"A última coisa que queremos é que Estados párias tomem medidas por conta própria, como, por exemplo, o ataque ao Tribunal Penal Internacional", discursou. "Minha mensagem aos líderes é que vocês têm uma obrigação legal (...) de proteger os direitos humanos, abster-se da guerra e tornar realidade a Carta das Nações Unidas".

Pillay também se disse surpresa com o elogio do Comitê do Nobel à sua coragem, citada um dos fatores decisivo na escolha de seu nome.

"Uma das principais reações a esse relatório foi uma homenagem à minha coragem. Por que seria necessário ter coragem para dizer a verdade? Você interpreta a lei, analisa todos os fatos. Trata-se, portanto, de uma tomada de decisão imparcial", afirmou.

Por fim, Pillay disse também que atualmente atua como juíza em um processo movido pela Gâmbia contra Mianmar, e disse que não pensa em parar no momento apesar de ter 85 anos.

articles.title: Ladeira na Zona Sul de João Pessoa é interditada para obras de ponte neste sábado (10) | G1
articles.standfirst: Bloqueio no trânsito de veículos afeta também o transporte coletivo e a Semob-JP orienta para utilização de rotas alternativas.
articles.summary: Bloqueio no trânsito de veículos afeta também o transporte coletivo e a Semob-JP orienta para utilização de rotas alternativas.
articles.body:
Ladeira na Zona Sul de João Pessoa é interditada para obras de ponte neste sábado (8) — Foto: Divulgação/Semob-JP

Um trecho da Ladeira entre os bairros Mangabeira e Valentina, na Zona Sul de João Pessoa , será interditada neste sábado (10) para o içamento de vigas da ponte do Rio Cuiá. O bloqueio para o trânsito de veículos ocorre das 7h às 18h.

De acordo com a Superintendência Executiva de Mobilidade Urbana de João Pessoa (Semob-JP), agentes de mobilidade, viaturas e sinalização móvel estarão no trecho do bloqueio para orientar os condutores.

O bloqueio ocorre devido a movimentação das máquinas pesadas envolvidas no içamento das estruturas de concreto que farão parte da base da ponte em construção.

Durante a interdição do trecho para as obras, os condutores poderão utilizar o acesso no final da Avenida Alfredo Ferreira da Rocha em Mangabeira, para quem segue em direção ao bairro Valentina.

Durante interdição do trecho, rotas alternativas são indicadas aos condutores. — Foto: Thiago Ferreira/Semob-JP

Já quem segue no sentido contrário, em direção ao bairro de Mangabeira, a rota indicada é a Rua Roberto Duarte de Lima, no Valentina.

As linhas de ônibus 1500, 5100, 2300, 3200, 9901 e E901 serão desviadas por Nova Mangabeira e pela PB-008 durante a interdição.

Os ônibus que seguem em direção à Valentina passarão pela PB-008 e Nova Mangabeira, saindo na Av. Emília Mendonça Gomes.

No sentido inverso, sentido Mangabeira, os ônibus seguirão por Nova Mangabeira e PB-008, depois o itinerário normal, pela Avenida Josefa Taveira.

articles.title: CGU abre concurso com 60 vagas e salário de R$ 20 mil | G1
articles.standfirst: Oportunidades são para candidatos com nível superior. Inscrições ficam abertas de 10 de outubro a 4 de novembro, com provas previstas para dezembro.
articles.summary: Seleção exige nível superior e prevê jornada de 40 horas semanais; inscrições vão de 10 de outubro a 4 de novembro.
articles.body:
Fachada da Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) — Foto: Kenzo Suzuki ASCOM/CGU

A Controladoria-Geral da União ( CGU ) publicou nesta sexta-feira (9) o edital de um novo concurso público com 60 vagas imediatas , além da formação de cadastro de reserva.

As oportunidades são destinadas a candidatos com nível superior, com salário inicial de R$ 20 mil e jornada de trabalho de 40 horas semanais . As vagas estão distribuídas em quatro cargos:

Tecnologia da Informação (TI) – Ciência de Dados: 10 vagas;

TI – Desenvolvimento de Sistemas: 10 vagas.

Para o cargo de Auditoria, são oferecidas 20 vagas na sede da CGU, em Brasília, e outras 10 distribuídas entre as unidades regionais do Acre, Amapá, Mato Grosso, Rondônia e Roraima, com duas vagas em cada estado.

As três áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) têm lotação no Distrito Federal e oferecem 10 vagas imediatas cada.

O concurso prevê a possibilidade de aprovação de até 368 candidatos no total , incluindo os classificados dentro do número de vagas imediatas.

Desse limite, até 206 aprovados serão para o cargo de Auditoria e até 54 para cada uma das três especialidades de Tecnologia da Informação (TI). Os candidatos aprovados além das vagas imediatas poderão compor o cadastro de reserva.

O concurso reserva 5% das vagas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Além disso, 30% das oportunidades são destinadas a ações afirmativas: 25% para pessoas pretas e pardas, 3% para indígenas e 2% para quilombolas.

As inscrições estarão abertas de 10 de outubro a 4 de novembro de 2026, exclusivamente pela internet, no site do Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisa em Avaliação e Seleção e de Promoção de Eventos (Cebraspe), banca responsável pela organização do concurso.

A taxa de inscrição é de R$ 170, com pagamento até 6 de novembro . Podem solicitar isenção da taxa candidatos inscritos no Cadastro Único para Programas Sociais do Governo Federal (CadÚnico) e doadores de medula óssea cadastrados em entidades reconhecidas pelo Ministério da Saúde.

O pedido de isenção deverá ser feito entre 10 e 16 de outubro. Já as provas objetiva e discursiva serão aplicadas em 13 de dezembro , em todas as capitais do país ( veja o cronograma completo abaixo ).

A avaliação será dividida em dois turnos . Pela manhã, os candidatos responderão à prova objetiva, com duração de cinco horas. À tarde, será aplicada a etapa discursiva, com duração de três horas e meia.

A prova objetiva terá 170 itens no modelo de julgamento “certo ou errado” , distribuídos em três blocos: 40 de conhecimentos básicos, 40 de conhecimentos complementares e 90 de conhecimentos específicos.

Já a prova discursiva será composta por duas questões. A primeira abordará conhecimentos complementares e valerá 30 pontos. A segunda apresentará uma situação-problema relacionada à área específica do cargo e valerá 70 pontos.

Os locais e horários individuais de aplicação das provas serão divulgados em 2 de dezembro . Os candidatos deverão comparecer ao local designado com pelo menos uma hora de antecedência em relação ao início da avaliação.

O concurso terá validade de dois anos , contados a partir da homologação do resultado final no Diário Oficial da União (DOU), podendo ser prorrogado uma única vez por igual período.

articles.title: Imagens aéreas mostram avião em chamas sobre trilhos do metrô de BH | G1
articles.standfirst: Aeronave caiu próximo à Estação São Gabriel, na Região Nordeste da capital, nesta sexta-feira (9). O piloto morreu carbonizado, segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros.
articles.summary: Aeronave caiu próximo à Estação São Gabriel, na Região Nordeste da capital, nesta sexta-feira (9). O piloto morreu carbonizado, segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros.
articles.body:
Imagens aéreas feitas pelo Globocop mostram o avião que caiu e pegou fogo sobre os trilhos do metrô de Belo Horizonte , próximo à Estação São Gabriel, nesta sexta-feira (9). O piloto, que ainda não teve a identidade divulgada pelas autoridades, era o único ocupante e morreu carbonizado.

Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, na queda, a aeronave colidiu contra uma estrutura do galpão do Metrô BH, concessionária responsável pelo serviço metroviário na capital, e atingiu a fiação elétrica do pátio de manutenção.

O monomotor, de matrícula PT-VHE e modelo Embraer EMB-711ST Corisco II Turbo, havia decolado do Aeroporto da Pampulha e faria um pouso em Juatuba, na Grande BH, retornando em seguida para Belo Horizonte.

Conforme Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Anac), o avião está em situação regular e tem certificado de inspeção válido até outubro de 2027. Ele está registrado para uso privado e não possui autorização para operações comerciais, como táxi aéreo ou transporte regular de passageiros.

De acordo com o superintendente de operação e manutenção do Metrô BH, Roberto Fischer Machado, não há registros de funcionários feridos ou vagão na linha férrea danificado. A circulação dos trens segue normalmente.

Em nota, a Companhia de Energia Elétrica de Minas Gerais (Cemig) informou que não há registro de danos à rede de distribuição de energia na região da estação São Gabriel.

Para permitir o trabalho de bombeiros militares, apenas a energia do pátio de manutenção foi desligada.

articles.title: US sued over plan to blast Utah canyon inscribed by 19th century 'Buffalo Soldiers,' European pioneers
articles.summary: By Andrew Hay Oct 8 (Reuters) - Conservation groups sued the US government this week over plans to blast the cliff walls of an eastern Utah canyon and build...
articles.body:
Oct 8 (Reuters) - Conservation groups sued the US government this week over plans to blast the cliff walls of an eastern Utah canyon and build an oil truck ‌highway through an area covered in historic inscriptions and near world-renowned Native rock art.

The project to ‌replace a winding dirt track with a paved road through Gate Canyon would destroy 100-foot (30-meter) cliffs with at least 47 historic sites, ​including 19th century inscriptions by Black American "Buffalo Soldiers" in the US Army and European pioneers, according to the lawsuit against the US Bureau of Land Management. The cliffs are also a habitat for threatened species such as the Mexican spotted owl, the suit claims.

A spokesperson for the US Department of the Interior, the bureau's parent agency, said it ‌had no comment due to pending ⁠litigation.

Gate Canyon runs north off Nine Mile Canyon, described as the world's longest art gallery, according to the Bureau of Land Management. Nine Mile Canyon, which is about 46 ⁠miles (74 km) long, is home to the United States' largest concentration of Native rock art with more than 1,000 art sites containing over 10,000 images, some dating to prehistoric times.

The plan to pave Gate Canyon as an alternative truck route ​to ​the Uinta Basin oil fields would turn Nine Mile Canyon ​into a busy oil highway, potentially damaging ‌one of Utah's most important cultural and scenic areas, the lawsuit claims.

"BLM rushed its April 2026 decision to approve the blasting and paving of Gate Canyon and hid that process from the public," says the 50-page lawsuit filed in US District Court District of Utah, Central Division.

Plaintiffs in the Utah lawsuit - including the Center for Biological Diversity - said the Bureau's approval of the road project proposed by Utah's Duchesne County violated a string of federal laws, including ‌the National Environmental Policy Act, National Historic Preservation Act and ​the Endangered Species Act.

Black US Army soldiers carved their names ​in the rock walls of Gate Canyon, located ​around 100 miles (160 km) southeast of Salt Lake City, when they built its current ‌road. Freighters and pioneers also inscribed their names ​on the canyon walls using ​axle grease, according to the plaintiffs.

The legal action comes weeks after a US judge blocked the administration of President Donald Trump from building a border barrier through Big Bend National Park in Texas while ​courts consider an environmental lawsuit challenging ‌that project.

Trump has pursued a "Drill, baby, drill" policy to expand domestic oil and gas production, speeding ​permits and loosening environmental restrictions in pursuit of US energy dominance.

(Reporting by Andrew Hay in ​New Mexico; Editing by Donna Bryson and Lincoln Feast.)

articles.title: Creators of October 7 play call fire alarm disruption at Northwestern a 'cowardly' attempt at intimidation
articles.summary: A fire alarm disrupted the play "OCTOBER 7" at Northwestern University's Cahn Auditorium, but defiant audience members returned to give a standing ovation.
articles.body: Theatergoers filed into the Cahn Auditorium at Northwestern University on Tuesday to see a play comprised of testimonies from those impacted by the 2023 Hamas attacks in Israel. As the attendees sat at the edge of their seats waiting to hear the fate of the people whose stories were told, a fire alarm went off, disrupting the evening. Ann McElhinney, who co-wrote the play "OCTOBER 7" with her husband, Phelim McAleer, told Fox News Digital that many audience members initially remained seated, believing the alarms were part of the show. "Initially, they thought it was part of the play because they heard these sirens going off, and the dialogue prior to that had been about sirens going off, rockets going off, the red alarm going off," McElhinney explained to Fox News Digital. "They were like 'Oh, this is part of the play,' until they realized it wasn't." JEWISH CAMPUS LIFE AT A ‘CROSSING POINT’ AS STUDENTS WEIGH ANTISEMITISM RISKS, NEW REPORT SHOWS After the theater had been evacuated and cleared by authorities, many people left, according to McElhinney, who told Fox News Digital that she believed that people were scared by the incident. However, she said others who chose to stay, feeling "defiant" and refusing "to be terrified by this." McAleer noted that the performance ended with a standing ovation, which he believed was both a tribute to those who worked on the show and those who returned after the alarm went off. "The standing ovation was for the actors, the standing ovation was for the director, the standing ovation was for the stories. But it's also, I think people were giving themselves a standing ovation that someone had tried to intimidate them, that someone had tried to say to them, 'You're not going to tell the truth. We don't want to hear the truth, we want to shut you up, we want to shut down, we want to frighten you and intimidate you.' And they didn't succeed," McAleer told Fox News Digital. In response to Fox News Digital's request for comment, Northwestern Media Relations said in a statement, "At approximately 8:12 p.m., a fire alarm at Cahn Auditorium was activated, which caused the evacuation of the building. Upon a fire and police investigation, the building was determined safe, and guests invited back in. The event continued as planned and concluded at 9:45 p.m. The Northwestern University Police Department will continue their investigation." CAMPUS ANTISEMITISM EXTENDS BEYOND STUDENT PROTESTS AND INTO CLASSROOMS, ADL WARNS While the play was disrupted, McAleer and McElhinney said there were no protesters outside the venue at the start of the show. McAleer told Fox News Digital that while "people are perfectly entitled to protest outside the venue," what happened inside the theater was "more insidious." The couple said they believe someone deliberately activated the fire alarm after sitting through much of the performance. "This was someone, we believe, someone sat through the play and then came out at the most emotional time," McAleer told Fox News Digital. "It's something very insidious that someone decided to disrupt this rather than even, by the way, have a protest, make their voice heard. But no, they decided they didn't want their — they did the sneaky, cowardly, insidious, nasty thing of setting off a fire alarm, causing huge fear and just absolute nervousness among the people who were there and caused this trauma on the anniversary of October 7," McAleer added. McAleer pointed out that while it was still Oct. 6 in Chicago where the play was held, it was already Oct. 7 in Israel when the fire alarm was activated. 'I AM OMER': FORMER HAMAS HOSTAGE REFLECTS ON SURVIVING 505 HARROWING DAYS IN CAPTIVITY The spoken-word play is a collection of testimonies that McAleer and McElhinney compiled when they went to Israel shortly after the Oct. 7 attacks. McElhinney told Fox News Digital that the couple had been in Ireland as the attacks took place and were stunned to find that people were criticizing Israel's response the following day, seemingly overlooking the attacks themselves. "We realized that if we didn't go and tell the story and do this work that, you know, it looks very much like nobody else was going to do that," McElhinney told Fox News Digital. McAleer echoed a similar sentiment, saying that shortly after the attacks, they noticed that "everyone from journalists from the establishment, from university campuses — they all wanted to talk about the war in Gaza, but nobody wanted to talk about October 7th." "Journalism is supposed to be the first rough draft of history. Nobody was writing that draft," he added. The couple traveled to Israel — a place neither had visited before — rented a car and began trying to contact people willing to share their stories. McElhinney recalled that their hotel in Tel Aviv had a makeshift memorial for an employee who had been killed at the Nova music festival. McAleer and McElhinney ultimately interviewed approximately 20 people, with testimony from 15 included in the play. In addition to Northwestern University, the play, titled "OCTOBER 7," has been performed in New York City, Princeton, UCLA, Bowdoin College and the Kennedy Center. While the incident at Northwestern was noteworthy, it was not the first time the couple had to deal with security for their production. McElhinney explained that during the play's New York City run, the production had a daily NYPD presence. She said she believed it was the only New York play in living memory to require police protection every day. "That tells you something about free speech in New York City," McElhinney said. She pointed out that the play, which focuses on the experiences of Israelis, including Jewish survivors of the attacks, needed security while being performed in a city with a large Jewish population. MIKE WALTZ FIGHTS BACK TEARS REVEALING WHAT HAMAS HOSTAGE REFUSED TO DO BEFORE RELEASE Ultimately, McAleer said the incident at Northwestern revealed something about the state of American college campuses. "American campuses are deeply strange, dangerous places at the moment for a Jewish person," he said. "You mean, you can't mourn your dead. You can't mark your anniversaries. You can't walk the campus without fear of being attacked or having your event disrupted." "You know you can have an event without massive and expensive security," McAleer added. "What does that say about the campus idea of freedom and free speech and free thought? Free thought is dead on American campus[es]. Free speech seems to be dead on the American campuses." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP McAleer told Fox News Digital that the couple planned to file a police report about the incident and that "we hope that whoever did this feels a full force of the law because this cannot be allowed to stand."

articles.title: South Korea and Japan are buffeted by hacks as AI lowers bar for cybercriminals
articles.summary: South Korean and Japanese companies are racing to strengthen cyber defenses after a wave of attacks that cybersecurity experts say are highlighting how AI may be lowering the bar for criminals with limited technical skills.
articles.body: South Korean and Japanese companies are racing to strengthen cyber defenses after a wave of attacks that cybersecurity experts say are highlighting how AI may be lowering the bar for criminals with limited technical skills. Nine South Korean banks and two mega-churches are investigating cyberattacks that may have involved AI tools, while Japanese companies including Daiwa Securities, SoftBank and the Lawson convenience store chain have been hit by a recent surge in cyber incidents. Authorities are still investigating whether and how AI was used in many of the breaches. But cybersecurity specialists say the technology is helping attackers automate tasks from scanning for software vulnerabilities to crafting phishing campaigns, making cybercrime faster, cheaper and harder to detect. “AI doesn’t get tired ... My view is that Japan is essentially being subjected to carpet bombing,” said Nobuo Miwa, president of the Tokyo-based cybersecurity firm S&J Corp. Japan recorded more cybersecurity incidents in the first nine months of the year than in all of last year, according to data from TrendAI. Incidents rose to 86 in September, up about 18% from August and 37% from July. The rise suggests attackers have crossed a threshold in “effort, motivation and technical capability,” while AI has largely erased language and other barriers that once hindered foreign hackers, Miwa said. U.S. cybersecurity company CrowdStrike said a 26-year-old China-based attacker suspected of being behind the South Korean bank incidents would probably not have been able to carry out the campaign without AI assistance. The individual, whom CrowdStrike assessed was pursuing financial gain, used a Chinese-developed AI agent and Anthropic’s Claude Code, according to the company. “While (the hacker’s) capabilities were not terribly sophisticated, they were effective,” said Adam Meyers, CrowdStrike’s senior vice president of counter adversary operations. AI-powered tools are also making it harder for defenders to spot suspicious behavior, said Choi Kyoungjin, director of the Center for AI, Data and Policy at Gachon University near Seoul. “With general-purpose AI models, even ordinary users with malicious intent can ask the system to look for vulnerabilities and it will do much of that work for them,” he said. South Korea reported 1,236 cyber incidents in the first half of the year, up 20% from a year earlier. While server hacking cases fell, reports of distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks and ransomware rose 56.7% and 76.8%, respectively, according to government data. The South Korean bank incidents underscore the need for stronger security controls and more rigorous testing as AI evolves, Meyers said. “The genie is out of the bottle, so to speak.” Although the breaches have not yet resulted in material financial losses, risks could increase if stolen data is used in phishing or similar text-message “smishing” campaigns, Karen Wu, senior analyst at Fitch, wrote in a note. “We expect the incidents to result in regulatory penalties, customer compensation costs, and a sector-wide increase in cybersecurity spending,” Wu said. Warnings about AI’s growing role in cybercrime are increasingly coming from the technology’s developers. Anthropic and Alphabet’s Google have both warned that AI-assisted attacks are becoming more common globally. “At this point, we can assume that all threat actors are using AI in some capacity and their operations have benefited,” John Hultquist, the chief analyst at Google’s Threat Intelligence Group, said last month. Regulators in Japan and South Korea have begun responding. South Korea’s Financial Services Commission has directed financial industry associations, regulators and affected executives to complete a 12-point cybersecurity self-assessment. In Japan, digital transformation minister Toshiharu Furukawa convened a meeting of ministries and agencies on Thursday following the recent attacks. The National Cybersecurity Office plans to issue warnings to businesses. S&J’s Miwa said he expected elevated levels of cyberattacks to persist. “The attackers have experienced a breakthrough that has rendered many of the old assumptions obsolete,” he said. “Our defenses need their own breakthrough as well.”

articles.title: Malaysia closes schools in several states due to haze from Indonesia forest fires
articles.summary: Schools in several Malaysian states as well as its federal and administrative capitals will be closed on Friday, the education ministry said, after smoky haze caused by forest fires in neighboring Indonesia pushed air pollution to unhealthy levels.
articles.body: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia — Schools in several Malaysian states as well as its federal and administrative capitals will be closed on Friday, the education ministry said, after smoky haze caused by forest fires in neighboring Indonesia pushed air pollution to unhealthy levels. The areas affected include the states of Johor, Malacca, Negeri Sembilan and Selangor on the Malaysian peninsular, as well as the country’s capital, Kuala Lumpur, and its administrative center, Putrajaya, Education Minister Fadhlina Sidek said in a Facebook post late Thursday. Schools will also be closed in the Rompin district of Pahang state, she said. “I have asked all state education departments and district education offices to continue to monitor the haze situation and take immediate action if the situation requires it,” she said. Malaysia’s Air Pollutant Index classifies air quality as “unhealthy” from 101 to 200, “very unhealthy” from 201 to 300, and “hazardous” above 300. On Friday morning, 37 areas recorded unhealthy API levels, according to government data. Indonesia has struggled to contain forest and land fires across several provinces that have led to thick haze in neighboring nations including Malaysia and Singapore. Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Thursday that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto had agreed to take necessary steps to combat the haze, with Malaysia ready to offer assistance. Anwar said he had asked Malaysia’s foreign minister to push for a meeting of ministers from the Southeast Asian bloc ASEAN to coordinate a regional response and support Indonesia’s efforts.

articles.body: Saudi Arabia’s civil aviation authority said on Friday that three Saudi nationals were killed and several people were injured in two ⁠attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Thursday. In a statement on X, the General Authority of Civil Aviation said the first attack targeted airport facilities, while ⁠the second struck an aircraft ​belonging ⁠to Saudi state carrier Saudia. The injuries ranged from minor to severe, and the attacks caused material ⁠damage, it said, adding that airport operations had resumed ​and ⁠air traffic had returned ‌to normal. Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis said on Thursday they had attacked the airport with two cruise missiles. The ‌group also said it had targeted ‌an airport in the southwestern city of Najran, a claim Saudi authorities have not confirmed, and an airbase in Khamis Mushait ⁠with ballistic missiles. The Houthis say they are targeting the kingdom over its support for government forces in Yemen’s reignited civil war. Saudi Arabia says it is backing an offensive by Yemen’s U.N.-recognized government to take back territory from the Houthis. The latest confirmed casualties come after ‌Saudi authorities said on Wednesday that three ​people were killed in earlier strikes this week ‌on Riyadh airport and ⁠Abha airport in the southwest of the country. The ⁠conflict, now an overspill of the US-Iran war, has stoked further ‌upheaval in ​a region already destabilized by ‌the wider war, and threatens ​to draw other states into mountain fighting.

articles.title: Leading pro-Kremlin war blogger detained in Montenegro
articles.summary: Russian pro-Kremlin military blogger Mikhail Zvinchuk, founder of the influential Rybar Telegram channel, has been detained in Montenegro along with several associates.
articles.body: Russian pro-Kremlin military blogger Mikhail Zvinchuk, founder of the influential Rybar Telegram channel, has been detained in Montenegro along with several associates, Montenegrin authorities said Friday. Rybar, which British and US authorities have accused of spreading Kremlin propaganda and disinformation, has more than 1.5 million subscribers. Since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, pro-Kremlin war bloggers have become a key cog in Russia’s propaganda machine, providing battlefield updates while maintaining a pro-conflict stance. Many of the military bloggers have deep sources within the state’s armed forces, which gives them unparalleled access to information. Montenegro’s prime minister said the move by the country’s security services came in response to information that the Rybar network could try to “destabilize” the Balkan country through a campaign of disinformation. “Montenegro is protecting its interests, and no one will jeopardize our European future,” Prime Minister Milojko Spajic said on X. Russia’s Foreign Ministry confirmed Zvinchuk’s detention and said it was seeking further information. The Montenegrin outlet Vijesti reported that Zvinchuk, his wife Valeriya and three other individuals had been detained Friday morning in the coastal town of Risan. Zvinchuk has been under British sanctions since last December for his involvement in “destabilising Ukraine” and undermining its territorial integrity. Ukraine’s defense intelligence describes Zvinchuk as one of the most prominent proponents of Russia’s aggression against Ukraine. Through his Rybar channel, Zvinchuk “systematically disseminates disinformation aimed at justifying the invasion, discrediting the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and delegitimizing the Ukrainian government,” a description of him on Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence War Sanctions portal reads. The UK and the European Union have both sanctioned Zvinchuk. The UK government said Rybar had “the appearance of a reliable news source, principally focussed on military analysis of the war in Ukraine,” but covertly acted on behalf of the Russian state and attempted to interfere in democratic elections. The United States has separately accused Zvinchuk of attempting to interfere in its 2024 presidential election.

articles.title: Northampton man sentenced over post threatening Lucy Connolly
articles.summary: Jake Newman receives a 12-month community order at Birmingham Crown Court.
articles.body:
A man has been given a 12-month community order after leaving a threatening Facebook comment about Lucy Connolly, who was jailed for stirring up racial hatred.

Jake Newman, 35, from Kingsley Road, Northampton, pleaded guilty to sending a communication threatening death or serious harm when he wrote: "Time to treat her house the way she wanted hotels treated, just make sure she's in it and not able to get out."

Connolly was jailed in 2024 after she called for people to "set fire" to hotels housing asylum seekers in the wake of the Southport attack , where three girls were murdered and others injured.

At his sentencing on Thursday at Birmingham Crown Court, Judge Smith told Newman he had committed a "dangerous, potentially very risky criminal act".

On 22 August 2025, Newman wrote the comment beneath a Northampton Chronicle Facebook post that included an article about Connolly's release.

Northamptonshire Police attended Newman's address the same day and arrested him after the comment was reported.

Newman admitted to officers he made the comment, but said he had no intention of causing alarm or distress or of inciting others to take action.

He was due to face trial after initially denying the charge, but later changed his plea to guilty.

Defending Newman, Diane Mundill said the defendant had been scrolling on his phone while awaiting medication at a time when he was "anxious".

She said he had demonstrated positive progress and now has "greater insight into his behaviour".

The judge accepted that Newman had been suffering from the effects of an acquired brain injury, which included impulsivity.

Of the Facebook post, the judge said: "You did not read the [newspaper] article but were familiar with the background.

"You did, however, read other messages that seemed supportive of the individual and this frustrated you.

"You posted a comment the next day which read: 'Time to treat her house the way she wanted hotels treated, just make sure she's in it and not able to get out'.

"When you posted that comment, you were reckless as to whether an individual would fear the threat of death.

"Whilst you did not wish the individual to feel fear, that was a very real risk of what you said."

The court heard Newman had previous convictions, including some that were "loosely related to internet misuse", but he was assessed as being a low risk of further offending.

The judge said: "I accept you are now remorseful."

When handing Newman the 12-month community order with a probation requirement, Smith warned he would face prison if he refused to comply with the sentence.

articles.title: ‘Indentured servants’: US green card move will hit thousands of IT workers
articles.summary: The US is suspending top tech firms, including Microsoft, from a key programme to sponsor foreign workers’ green cards.
articles.body:
The United States government has moved to exclude some of the world’s top tech companies from a programme that allows them to sponsor skilled foreign workers for permanent residency.

Vice President JD Vance said the action was a response to companies abusing the system to hire lower-paid foreign workers at the expense of US workers.

It comes as US President Donald Trump’s administration continues efforts to clamp down on immigration – both legal and undocumented – and make it harder for immigrants to get residency or citizenship.

But the latest move also potentially impacts thousands of foreign workers, many of whom have spent years waiting for a backlog in applications to clear.

Here’s what to know about the latest policy:

The suspension concerns the Permanent Labour Certification (PERM) programme, which enables a US-based employer to sponsor a foreign worker’s green card — as the permanent residency is commonly known. To qualify, the employer is supposed to demonstrate that there are insufficient US workers for a needed job role and that bringing a foreign worker will not impact the pay or conditions of US workers in the industry.

PERM is a key step in the green card process for many skilled foreign workers. Major tech companies often hire workers on temporary visas, such as the H-1B, before they transition to permanent residency through the PERM process.

Vance on Thursday accused major companies of fraudulently using the current visa regime to displace US employees and bring in lower-paid foreign workers who amount to “indentured servants”.

“The programme has become rife with fraud,” said Vance at a White House news conference. He claimed that many workers who start off on temporary H-1B visas and later apply for permanent residency under the PERM programme are “being mistreated by their employers” and “used to undercut the wages of American workers”.

“You’ve got to hire great American workers,” the US vice president said. “You cannot lay off American workers and then replace them with foreign indentured servants.”

Labour Secretary Keith Sonderling used similar language, saying the US would “shut down the pipeline of systemic fraud that has flooded our country”.

“The fraud doesn’t end with getting the job,” said Sonderling. “That job becomes a pathway for foreign workers and their families to stay in America permanently and eventually (become) US citizens.”

“And who pays for it all? The American worker,” he said.

Vance singled out Microsoft as a major offender and said it would be suspended from the PERM programme.

Other companies whose PERM applications will no longer be processed include US software firm Adobe and some of the world’s top IT firms, including Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini. Of these, Capgemini is French, Microsoft and Adobe are American, and the rest — Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro and HCL — are all Indian.

“We will not accept any new or process any pending permanent labour certification applications involving these companies,” said Sonderling.

Vance said the suspensions would continue “as long as it needs to”.

Other companies that rely heavily on H-1B visas such as Meta, Amazon or Alphabet’s Google will not be affected.

Have tech firms been abusing US immigration rules?

Critics of the H-1B visa and PERM green card process argue that some employers use the system not to fill legitimate skills shortages, but to reduce labour costs, gain leverage over workers and make it harder for US employees to compete for jobs. They say companies do this by hiring foreign workers at lower wages and manipulating recruitment conditions to keep out qualified US workers.

Vance said Microsoft last year let go 6,000 US workers, while also securing 6,300 H-1B visas and almost 3,000 green cards.

“If you do the math, for every worker that Microsoft laid off, they replaced that worker with one and a half foreign indentured servants,” said Vance.

Sonderling said companies being suspended from PERM had received more than 230,000 H-1B visas and over 100,000 permanent labour certifications since 2009.

“That’s hundreds of thousands of jobs that were taken from American workers,” Sonderling said.

The H1-B visa system has also emerged as a lightning rod for many of the most vocal backers of Trump’s Make America Great Again (MAGA) movement, some of whom have married criticism of the programme with anti-immigrant stereotypes — particularly against Indians — to demand that the scheme be scrapped.

Microsoft disputed the implication that its visa filings represented new hires replacing US workers. In a statement, the company said that 80 percent of the roughly 6,000 H1-B visa applications it issued last year were “to extend or change the status of existing Microsoft employees”, not for new employees, and that the other filings were for “individuals already legally in the United States”.

The company also said that it only files applications for people who “meet the rigorous standards of this visa category” and that such employees are paid equally to any others who do similar work.

What does this mean for foreign workers?

The suspension could make it harder for foreign workers in the tech industry to obtain permanent residency in the US. Many of those affected are likely to be Indian nationals, who account for a large share of the country’s skilled foreign workforce in the technology sector.

Each year, there are only 85,000 slots for new H-1B visas (not including filings for renewals), but hundreds of thousands of applications. Many H-1B visa holders work in technology-related jobs: 62 percent of the beneficiaries in the 2025 fiscal year worked in computer-related occupations.

Indian nationals account for roughly 70 percent of existing H-1B visa holders.

The Trump administration has already tried to crack down on the H1-B scheme, and in August proposed a new $103,000 fee for H1-B applications, after an earlier pitch for a similar fee was struck down by a federal court. The fee, the government argues, would help provide revenue that could be used to service the vast US immigration system, while reducing the incentive for companies to attempt to misuse H1-B visas.

But the new move to restrict the pathway to a green card for foreign workers already in the US, legally, could impact not just those who might have dreamed of working or living in the US — but thousands already in the country.

The US typically issues around 140,000 employment-based green cards every year. But it also has a strict country-based cap — applicants from any one country cannot receive more than seven percent of green cards issued in a year.

Yet, because the employment-based green card application system is largely used to convert many H1-B visa holders into permanent residents, applicants for permanent residency are disproportionately Indian.

The result: Nearly one million Indians legally in the US on work visas are currently stuck in the employment-based green card backlog. They represent 79 percent of the total green card backlog of around 1.25 million people.

Even before the latest move, Indian green card applicants in certain employment categories would have needed to wait for decades, according to a 2025 analysis for the Congressional Research Service.

Sonderling’s statement that the US will no longer process “any pending permanent labour certification applications” from the blacklisted companies has raised fears that tens of thousands of foreign workers in the country legally — most of them Indian — who have waited for years might suddenly no longer be eligible. For others, the wait could get even longer.

Yes. India’s Ministry of External Affairs issued a statement saying the US’s suspension does not “advance the shared ambitions of both countries”.

The ministry said that “talent mobility adds value” to both the Indian and US economies, including providing US companies “with cutting-edge talent, innovation, research, productivity, competitiveness and job creation”.

The ministry also criticised comments by Vance comparing foreign workers to indentured servants as “unwarranted” and “deeply offensive”, saying his words recalled “painful historical and colonial legacy connotations”.

Colonial powers — the British, Dutch and French — took more than 1.6 million Indian workers as indentured labourers to work on plantations and build railways in their other colonies: in Malaysia, Mauritius, South Africa, Kenya, Uganda, Fiji, Suriname, Guyana and other Caribbean countries.

India’s foreign ministry said Vance’s descriptions also “ignore the fact that Indian professionals in the United States are highly educated and skilled contributors to its economy and innovation ecosystem”.

articles.title: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to discuss ‘new’ peace plan with Ukrainian delegation, sources say
articles.summary: Ukrainian negotiators heading to the United States for a new round of talks to end the war with Russia will discuss a comprehensive new plan to help break the ongoing impasse in the conflict, a senior administration official told NBC News.
articles.body: Ukrainian negotiators heading to the United States for a new round of talks to end the war with Russia will discuss a comprehensive new plan to help break the ongoing impasse in the conflict, a senior administration official told NBC News. The talks starting Friday and led by special envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner are the latest attempt to negotiate a settlement amid intensifying deadly aerial attacks on both sides of the border. The discussions will center on “a new, unified proposal that is focused on all aspects of the conflict to try to end the war,” the senior administration official said Thursday evening. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian delegation will travel to the U.S. for two days of negotiations, and include Rustem Umerov, the head of the country’s Foreign Intelligence Service, and Kyrylo Budanov, who heads the office of the president. Zelenskyy acknowledged a possible new phase in the negotiations. “We see on the part of the United States of America, an intensification of talks and meetings,” he told reporters, without mentioning any new proposals. “I myself have spoken with the American side three times in recent days, and I hope for a good result from our negotiators’ meeting.” Trump had vowed to swiftly end the conflict that began when Russia launched a full-scale invasion in February 2022. Despite numerous meetings and talks to broker a ceasefire since he took office, the two sides have been locked in a stalemate over the industrial region of Donbas in Ukraine’s east. Russian President Vladimir Putin has said that he wants to seize the entire region, parts of which Kyiv’s forces still hold. Zelenskyy has ruled out ceding this territory, arguing that Putin could use it as a base to again attack Ukraine. Russia currently occupies about one-fifth of Ukraine’s territory. Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned Thursday that stalemates are “very dangerous” because they either end in a negotiated settlement or escalation. In the context of Ukraine, that “could wind up being a sabotage campaign in neighboring countries that are members of NATO,” he said. European leaders are growing increasingly concerned about Russia escalating and expanding the conflict onto the continent. “In the end, we do not believe that there is a military solution to this conflict, to this war. We think this war needs to end in a negotiated settlement,” Rubio said. “The sooner, the better.” In separate comments to the Greek newspaper Kathimerini, Rubio said “there don’t seem to be prospects of a negotiated settlement” on peace in Ukraine right now. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov responded by saying he agreed with Rubio’s assessment, the Russian state news agency Tass reported. The U.S. diplomatic efforts to end the war were revived last month when Witkoff and Kushner traveled to Moscow and, for the first time, Kyiv. No major breakthroughs were announced. The White House has previously repeated some of Putin’s hard-line demands and tried to push Kyiv for concessions. Putin explained the invasion by saying Russia was trying to demilitarize Ukraine and overthrow Kyiv’s government, which he said is driven by “Nazi ideology” — a common Kremlin propaganda line. What was supposed to be a swift military operation to topple Zelenskyy and replace him with a pro-Kremlin government quickly foundered, leaving the capture of Donbas as Putin’s only option to claim a significant victory in Ukraine.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia reopens Riyadh airport after Houthi attack kills three
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia has seen several attacks by the Houthis in recent days, with airports appearing to be the primary target.
articles.body:
Saudi Arabia has reopened Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport following attacks by the Houthis that killed three people and injured several.

In a statement on social media on Friday, the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) said attacks the previous day had hit airport facilities and an aircraft belonging to state carrier Saudia.

The Houthis have hit Saudi airports in several attacks this week as the armed group continues to face an offensive by the Riyadh-backed internationally recognised Yemen government.

The strikes on Thursday caused injuries ranging from minor to severe, as well as material damage, GACA said. Airport operations have now resumed and air traffic has returned to normal.

Saudia Airlines said one of its pilots was killed and an aircraft was damaged.

“It is with profound sadness that Saudia announces the passing of Captain Hamoud Ali Alkalthami,” the flag-carrier said in a statement, citing an “incident” at the Riyadh airport.

Saudi Arabia has seen several attacks by the Houthis in recent days, with the airports appearing to be the primary target.

GACA said Wednesday that attacks earlier in the week had killed three civilians and injured 36 at Abha and King Khalid airports. At least three people were also wounded in other attacks on Jazan and Najran airports near the Yemen border.

A Houthi military spokesperson said on Thursday that the armed group had launched a ballistic missile towards King Khalid airport, claiming that the missile had successfully hit its intended target, causing damage and disrupting air traffic.

The campaign appears to be a revival of a tactic seen last month.

On September 18, Saudi-led coalition forces said they intercepted and destroyed a suspected Houthi ballistic missile fired towards King Khalid airport.

A day later, at least one explosion was heard near the airport in Riyadh, and a large plume of black smoke was seen rising from a fuel storage area.

The Houthis have warned aviation companies to avoid using Saudi airspace, saying any aircraft operating in there, except over the holy cities of Mecca and Medina, is a target.

The return to the attacks on Saudi Arabia’s airports comes as Yemeni forces continue a counteroffensive against the Houthis.

The push was launched after the Iran-aligned rebel group last month seized a broad swath of territory along the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait, which connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden, in a sudden push.

The Yemeni government forces this week claimed key gains around the Bab al-Mandeb coastline, but intense fighting continues.

The conflict, which was frozen for some years until it was brought back to life by the United States’ war on Iran, has stoked further upheaval in a region already destabilised by Israel’s wars on Gaza and Lebanon.

It now threatens to draw other states into the conflict, with Pakistan and Turkiye having agreed to deploy troops under a mutual defence pact signed with Saudi Arabia earlier this year.

A spokesman for Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on Friday that the country now has a “substantial number of forces as well as resources … in Riyadh”.

Pakistani military personnel “would not be crossing the borders of the other side for an attack on the Houthis, but of course (are acting) in the defence of the territory”, he noted.

The Saudi-led coalition supporting Yemen’s government said on Friday that it had destroyed three rocket launch platforms that were used by the Houthis “to threaten regional security”.

Spokesman Colonel Turki al-Maliki declared that all Houthi attacks on civilians and civilian facilities “will be met with resolve” by the Saudi-led coalition.

On Thursday, the coalition said it had intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles heading in the direction of Riyadh, and one missile in the direction of the city of Khamis Mushait, close to the Yemeni border.

Earlier in the week, its armed forces carried out 97 “precise targeting operations” against Houthi reinforcements on the Tor al-Baha front and the Taiz axis, using warplanes, drones, artillery, missiles and snipers, it added.

articles.title: ‘We want them out’: Mamdani demands ICE leave NYC after agent shoots man whose 5-year-old was in car
articles.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has demanded that US President Donald Trump end Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operations in the city after a
articles.body: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has demanded that US President Donald Trump end Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operations in the city after a federal immigration agent shot and injured a man in the Bronx while his five-year-old child was inside the car.“I am angry tonight. Because today ICE shot a New Yorker. They shot a New Yorker while his five-year-old child was in the car. ICE makes this city less safe. We want them out. Now,” Mamdani said in a video message following Thursday’s shooting.Mamdani said he had called Trump and would demand that the president end all ICE enforcement actions in New York City. “I will not stand by while ICE agents terrorize our communities,” he said in a statement.The mayor also called for ICE to be abolished and criticised the agency’s operations in the city.Speaking at a press conference later on Thursday, Mamdani said he had spoken with Trump and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin for about two hours but had failed to secure the release of the injured man.The shooting took place around 4 pm in Marble Hill, a residential neighbourhood in the Bronx. According to New York Police Department Commissioner Jessica Tisch, federal immigration agents were conducting a targeted operation to take a man identified as 28-year-old Oscar Belgal into custody.Belgal was inside a vehicle with a five-year-old boy, whom police believe to be his son, when the confrontation unfolded. Tisch said a plainclothes federal agent approached the driver’s side window with his gun drawn, while another agent stood near the vehicle’s headlight. The vehicle then moved forward, prompting at least one ICE agent to fire seven rounds, striking Belgal in the neck below his left ear.Police said the injured man was taken to New York-Presbyterian Allen Hospital in stable condition. The child was safe and had been placed in the care of a family member.Mamdani criticised the use of gunfire around a child. “There is no explanation for federal officers firing this many rounds into a car that has a five-year-old,” he said at the press conference.The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said an ICE officer had discharged his weapon during the operation and that agents immediately provided medical assistance to the injured man. The department described Belgal as an undocumented immigrant from the Dominican Republic with a prior conviction for grand larceny and multiple arrests. It also alleged that he had ties to the Trinitarios gang.The shooting drew criticism from other New York leaders. Governor Kathy Hochul said she had spoken with Trump and Mullin and urged them to halt ICE enforcement operations in the city. She also called for the release of any body-camera footage to establish what happened.Representative Ritchie Torres called the firing of multiple rounds into a car carrying a child “abhorrent and indefensible”, while Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer described the incident as deeply disturbing and called for an independent investigation.The incident has renewed tensions over the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement policies in New York. Mamdani, a vocal critic of ICE who has backed calls to abolish the agency, and Trump have maintained a relatively cordial public relationship despite their sharp differences over immigration.You use AI every day. articles.title: Long Lartin prison officer and inmate jailed over Snapchat fling
articles.summary: Ex-prison officer Jade Morris exchanged more than 5,000 illicit Snapchat messages with an inmate.
articles.body:
A former prison officer has been told she could have caused "untold harm" inside and outside the jail she worked at by sharing more than 5,000 illicit Snapchat messages with an inmate.

Jade Morris, who sent messages to convicted drug dealer Jerome Nunes' "contraband" mobile phone during a secret fling, was jailed for 12 months on Friday at Birmingham Crown Court.

Nunes, who was freed from a previous sentence almost two years ago, was jailed for nine months after being told he had "abused" his relationship with Morris.

The court was told on Thursday the pair used multiple phones to communicate after Morris started working at HMP Long Lartin in Worcestershire in 2022.

Morris, 37, of Holmer, Hereford, described the allegations against her as "ludicrous" at the start of a police inquiry launched after Nunes threw his illegally-held "encrypted" mobile phone out of his cell window.

But at a hearing in March she pleaded guilty to offences of misconduct in public office and encouraging Nunes to use a prohibited device.

Nunes, from Newport, south Wales, pleaded guilty at Birmingham Magistrates' Court in February to two offences under the Prison Act 1952 for possessing and using an unauthorised mobile phone.

The court heard the 35-year-old has 23 previous convictions for 31 offences and had been at Long Lartin serving a sentence for a drugs conspiracy offence imposed at Cardiff Crown Court in 2019.

Woman denies abortion clinic buffer zone charges

Passing sentence, Judge Peter Carr told the defendants: "Appropriate punishment can only be achieved by immediate custody."

Carr told Morris: "You had been working at the prison since January 2022. You were fully aware of your responsibilities."

The judge, who was told that Morris called in sick on the day after Nunes' phone was seized, said her account to police had not been credible.

He added: "You were clearly in an intimate relationship with Mr Nunes. I accept there was no evidence of a physical relationship."

Rejecting Morris' claims to have been frightened of Nunes, the judge added: "You could have reported matters but chose not to. I am quite satisfied that you willingly engaged in contact with Mr Nunes."

The judge said illegal possession of mobile phones within prisons undermined security and carried a potential to "cause untold harm inside and outside the establishment".

Georgina Davies, from the Crown Prosecution Service, said: "Prison officers hold positions of significant trust and responsibility.

"The public are entitled to expect that those working within the prison system will act with integrity and always maintain clear professional boundaries. This case involved a sustained and deliberate breach of that trust.

"Jade Morris knew that prisoners should not have access to mobile phones yet chose to engage in a prolonged relationship with Nunes, directly facilitating his criminal offending and undermining the security of the prison in which she worked.

"We hope this case sends a clear message that those who abuse positions of public trust will be held to account."
